  Source: https://readwise.io/mcp (HTTP 200, text/html). This is the Readwise marketing and setup page, not the MCP schema. The page does not list tool parameters, so I could not report them.
  
  (1) Server URL and connection
  
  - Server URL: https://mcp2.readwise.io/mcp
  - Claude Code setup, as given on the page, is a single command: `claude mcp add --transport http readwise https://mcp2.readwise.io/mcp`
  - Then, in Claude Code, run `/mcp`, select **readwise**, and select **Authenticate**.
  - Auth: OAuth through your Readwise account (the page says "authorize with your Readwise account"). No API key is mentioned.
  - Fallback for clients without remote HTTP MCP support: `npx -y mcp-remote https://mcp2.readwise.io/mcp` as a stdio server.
  - The page also points to a separate Readwise CLI (`npm i -g @readwise/cli`, page at /cli) as an alternative that needs no MCP setup.
  
  (2) Tools listed on the page (names exactly as shown)
  
  - Readwise highlights: readwise_search_highlights, readwise_list_highlights, readwise_create_highlights, readwise_update_highlight, readwise_delete_highlight, readwise_get_daily_review
  - Reader documents: reader_search_documents, reader_list_documents (filtered by location, category, or tag), reader_create_document, reader_get_document_details, reader_move_documents, reader_bulk_edit_document_metadata (edits title, author, category, etc., up to 50 documents at a time), reader_export_documents, reader_get_export_documents_status
  - Reader tags: reader_list_tags, reader_add_tags_to_document, reader_remove_tags_from_document
  - Reader highlights: reader_get_document_highlights, reader_create_highlight, reader_add_tags_to_highlight, reader_remove_tags_from_highlight, reader_set_highlight_notes

The page does not say whether EPUB uploads appear there or what the category values are. Treat this as unconfirmed until the schema or a live call shows it. reader_search_documents and reader_get_document_details exist but are not described as EPUB-specific.
  - Tagging documents: Yes. reader_add_tags_to_document adds one or more tags to a Reader document, reader_remove_tags_from_document removes them, and reader_list_tags lists all tags. reader_bulk_edit_document_metadata lists "title, author, category, etc." and does not mention tags. Tags on highlights are separate: reader_add_tags_to_highlight, reader_remove_tags_from_highlight, and readwise_update_highlight (which can update tags on Readwise highlights).

cd /Volumes/DAL/GCcalibreBooks && for db in metadata.db GCcalibreBooks/metadata.db; do echo "== $db"; sqlite3 -separator ' | ' "file:$db?mode=ro&immutable=1" "select count(*), count(s.value) from books b left join custom_column_1 s on s.book=b.id;" ; sqlite3 -separator ' | ' "file:$db?mode=ro&immutable=1" "select s.value, count(*) from custom_column_1 s group by 1 order by 2 desc;"; done
